_comment: Font IDs that a font scan finds from --font-N in markup (#485). --font-N counts only as a whole custom property name: no letter, digit, underscore or hyphen right before the two hyphens or right after the number. Read by assets/js/__tests__/editor-font-kits.test.js (referencesFromHtml) and tests/Unit/FontVariableMatchTest.php (Typost::FONT_VARIABLE_PATTERN), so the PHP scans and the editor scan find the same IDs. ids: in order of first match, no repeats.
